book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: قطار المحيط الهادي بيقطع أمريكا كلها.
sentences.en: The Pacific Railroad crosses all America.

sentences.ar: من سانفرانسيسكو لنيويورك، تلات آلاف ميل، بسبع أيام.
sentences.en: From San Francisco to New York, three thousand miles, in seven days.

sentences.ar: قبل السكة، كان بده ستة أشهر.
sentences.en: Before the railway, it took six months.

sentences.ar: والقطار فيه عربات نوم، ومطعم، وصالون.
sentences.en: And the train had sleeping cars, a dining car, a saloon.

sentences.ar: وفوغ وعودا وفيكس وباسبارتو قعدوا بعربة وحدة.
sentences.en: And Fogg, Aouda, Fix and Passepartout sat in one car.
And mountains around them, and snow above.

sentences.ar: والقطار طالع، طالع، لحد ما وصل للقمة.
sentences.en: And the train climbing, climbing, until it reached the summit.
And on the way, the train stopped.
And Passepartout put his head out of the window.
A herd of buffalo, crossing the line.
Thousands.
Ten thousand.
More.

sentences.ar: وكل واحد ماشي على مهله، وما بيهتم بالقطار.
sentences.en: And each walking at its own pace, not caring about the train.
And Passepartout shouted: drive through them!

sentences.ar: والسائق قال: عشرة آلاف جاموس بيوقفوا قطار.
sentences.en: And the driver said: ten thousand buffalo can stop a train.
And Fogg did not look out of the window.
And they waited three hours.
And after the buffalo, night.
And the train moving through the dark, the snow shining.

sentences.ar: وعودا قالت لفوغ: يا سيد فوغ، خايفة.
sentences.en: And Aouda said to Fogg: Mr. Fogg, I am afraid.
Fogg said: of what?
She said: of Proctor.
I heard he is on this train.
And you promised him.
Fogg said: I promised him.
Aouda said: and if something happens?
Fogg said: nothing will.
I am playing cards.

sentences.ar: وفعلاً، فيكس جاب ورق، وقعدوا يلعبوا.
sentences.en: And indeed, Fix brought cards, and they sat down to play.
Fogg, Fix and Aouda.

sentences.ar: وعودا، اللي تعلمت من فوغ، صارت لاعبة ممتازة.
sentences.en: And Aouda, who had learned from Fogg, had become an excellent player.
And Passepartout walked between the cars, watching.

sentences.ar: وشاف بروكتور، بعربة تانية، نايم، وريحته ويسكي.
sentences.en: And saw Proctor, in another car, asleep, smelling of whisky.
And said: God grant he does not wake.
